# DevSparks DeployCheck — LLM Information Architecture & Documentation Map

> DevSparks DeployCheck is an open-source developer operations platform engineered by DevSparks India. It unifies pre-deployment code auditing, BYOK AI coding assistance, guided Linux VPS server deployment, and synthetic website monitoring into a single self-hosted dashboard.

## Core Capabilities
- **Pre-deployment Audit**: Static analysis for package.json dependencies, exposed credentials, missing environment variables, and Docker configurations.
- **BYOK AI Assistant**: Code diff review and remediation via OpenRouter (supporting DeepSeek, Claude, GPT-4o) with explicit human approval gates.
- **VPS Management**: Secure Linux server diagnostics over SSH with SHA-256 host verification.
- **Guided Deployment**: Zero-downtime release pipelines with automated preflight checks and health verifications.
- **Synthetic Monitoring**: Continuous HTTP/SSL uptime probes with incident alerting.

## Architecture & Governance
- Engine: Node.js + Next.js App Router + TypeScript + PostgreSQL
- Design Standard: Strict Light Theme Only (#F7F8FC, #FFFFFF, #17172A, #5938F5)
- Open Source License: MIT License
- Maintainer: DevSparks India
